description: Six flip flops and six trigger repeaters. A pulse into a flip flop turns its gate on and the next pulse turns it off, while a pulse into a repeater is passed straight out

params.text: Flips that flip flop by hand, and lights while its gate is on
Sends a pulse from that repeater's output by hand

inputs.text: A pulse flips that flip flop, turning its gate on if it was off and off if it was on
A pulse here is passed straight to that repeater's output

outputs.text: A copy of every pulse that flips that flip flop, whether it came from the jack or from the button
Carries +10V while that flip flop is on and 0V while it is off
A copy of every pulse arriving at that repeater, and of every press of its button
